subject.title: [F10] openclaw.end_reason always empty on session.ended spans

question: Should OpenClaw add a public `openclaw.end_reason` contract, and should that contract apply to trajectory `session.ended`, diagnostics-otel `openclaw.run`, or both?
rationale: Current main does not define this attribute, and the requested enum would become operator-facing telemetry API; automation should not choose the public surface or vocabulary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add shared end-reason contract
options.body: Define the enum once, derive it from existing terminal signals, and export it on the approved trajectory and OTel surfaces with docs and regression coverage.

options.title: Fold into related OTel issue
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/102018 own the broader session-terminal telemetry contract and close or resolve this request through that work after maintainers scope it.

options.title: Keep current fields and document them
options.body: Decline a new attribute for now and clarify that supported telemetry uses `status`, `openclaw.outcome`, and `openclaw.errorCategory` rather than an end-reason enum.

recommendation.title: Add shared end-reason contract
recommendation.body: Define the enum once, derive it from existing terminal signals, and export it on the approved trajectory and OTel surfaces with docs and regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent diagnostics/observability history among the likely owners and are a good routing candidate for the public telemetry contract choice.
